diff --git a/libavcodec/riscv/h264_mc_chroma.S b/libavcodec/riscv/h264_mc_chroma.S
index 79394b987d..58076be243 100644
--- a/libavcodec/riscv/h264_mc_chroma.S
+++ b/libavcodec/riscv/h264_mc_chroma.S
@@ -380,3 +380,62 @@ func h264_avg_chroma_mc2_rvv, zve32x
         li      t6, 2
         j       21b
 endfunc
+
+// 16-bit (high bit depth >= 9) H.264 chroma MC. Mirrors the general
+// 4-tap path of h264chroma_template.c exactly:
+//   r[i] = (A*s0[i] + B*s0[i+1] + C*s1[i] + D*s1[i+1] + 32) >> 6
+//   avg: dst[i] = (dst[i] + r[i] + 1) >> 1
+// with A=(8-x)(8-y), B=x(8-y), C=(8-x)y, D=xy. The A/B/C/D weighting
+// is depth-independent (weights sum to 64, no overflow for 16-bit
+// pixels), so a single kernel serves all bit depths > 8.
+// Signature: (uint16_t *dst, const uint16_t *src, ptrdiff_t stride,
+//             int h, int x, int y)  -- a0..a5
+.macro h264_chroma_mc16 op, w
+func ff_\op\()_h264_chroma_mc\w\()_16_rvv, zve32x
+        lpad    0
+        li      t0, 8
+        sub     t1, t0, a4              // 8 - x
+        sub     t2, t0, a5              // 8 - y
+        mul     t3, t1, t2              // A
+        mul     t4, a4, t2              // B
+        mul     t5, t1, a5              // C
+        mul     t6, a4, a5              // D
+        srai    a2, a2, 1               // stride in uint16 units
+        slli    a2, a2, 1               // ... back to bytes (row advance)
+        li      t0, 32                  // rounding bias
+1:
+        vsetivli zero, \w, e16, m1, ta, ma
+        vle16.v v0, (a1)                // s0[0..w-1]
+        addi    a6, a1, 2
+        vle16.v v1, (a6)                // s0[1..w]
+        add     a6, a1, a2
+        vle16.v v2, (a6)                // s1[0..w-1]
+        addi    a6, a6, 2
+        vle16.v v3, (a6)                // s1[1..w]
+        vwmulu.vx v4, v0, t3            // A*s0
+        vwmaccu.vx v4, t4, v1           // + B*s0[+1]
+        vwmaccu.vx v4, t5, v2           // + C*s1
+        vwmaccu.vx v4, t6, v3           // + D*s1[+1]
+        vsetvli zero, zero, e32, m2, ta, ma
+        vadd.vx v4, v4, t0              // + 32 (e32)
+        vnsrl.wi v6, v4, 6              // narrow + >> 6  -> e16 (separate dest)
+        vsetvli zero, zero, e16, m1, ta, ma
+.ifc \op, avg
+        vle16.v v5, (a0)
+        vaaddu.vv v6, v6, v5            // (dst + r + 1) >> 1
+.endif
+        vse16.v v6, (a0)
+        add     a1, a1, a2
+        add     a0, a0, a2
+        addi    a3, a3, -1
+        bnez    a3, 1b
+        ret
+endfunc
+.endm
+
+        h264_chroma_mc16 put, 8
+        h264_chroma_mc16 put, 4
+        h264_chroma_mc16 put, 2
+        h264_chroma_mc16 avg, 8
+        h264_chroma_mc16 avg, 4
+        h264_chroma_mc16 avg, 2
